flows.name: Discover: Home -> Discover -> Place Detail -> Map
flows.repository: places table in PostgreSQL with fallback to data/places/places.json

findings.description: Places list and detail endpoints properly resolve both UUIDs and slug/alias IDs with verified metadata and coordinates.
Local fallback to places.json is well-encapsulated for offline operation and does not duplicate API transforms.

flows.name: Plan: User request -> AI orchestration -> deterministic tools -> itinerary -> result
flows.repository: places table, canonical transport datasets, RuleBasedModelAdapter/LLM adapter

findings.description: Snapshot test in test_wave_b1_1_first_batch_provenance.py asserts alembic_version == 0019, failing because C5.4 applied migration 0020_transit_ride_observations.
AI intent parsing correctly distinguishes planning requests from provider status checks and triggers build_itinerary tool.

flows.name: Transit: Plan/place -> transport -> route -> geometry -> map

findings.description: Frontend test canonical_frontend_transit_sync.test.tsx has hardcoded count expectation of 173 instead of current sync count 179 in VERIFIED_TRANSIT_STOPS.
Transit geometry rendering fails closed for unresolved gaps (emits empty coordinates) and only renders road-following polylines.
Frontend compilation error: ServiceRecord interface in frontend/src/types/services.ts is missing coordinate_status, breaking tsc in npm run build.
B1.2 domain boundaries are strictly maintained; civic utilities do not leak into destination catalog or itinerary recommendations.

flows.name: Persistence: Save -> restart/session reload -> saved content
flows.repository: LocalStorage on client; saved_places table in PostgreSQL for authenticated sync

findings.description: LocalStorage provides immediate zero-friction guest saving; authenticated backend sync layers seamlessly without race conditions.
Saved items correctly survive page refreshes, browser restarts, and tab switching.

flows.name: Weather: Place -> backend weather -> client presentation
flows.repository: Open-Meteo / IMD upstream live weather adapter with deterministic cache
flows.ui_consumer: Navbar weather badge, StitchWeatherSection, Destination detail weather tab

findings.description: StitchNavbar.tsx line 36 provides a hardcoded fallback: weatherSummary = Bhubaneswar: 32C, Sunny, violating the anti-vibe weather truth rule.
Backend weather endpoints fail honestly with status UNAVAILABLE or ERROR when upstream fails, without synthesizing fake 0C.
